create_KittiDataModule: create a KittiDataModule instance with a config dict and optional TileManager for KITTI map localization data
setup_KittiDataModule_splits: run the KittiDataModule setup method to parse train val and test splits from KITTI data files
parse_split_KittiDataModule: parse a KITTI split file or list of date drive paths into image names and GPS shifts
get_frame_data_KittiDataModule: extract camera pose translation and roll pitch yaw Euler angles from a KITTI GPS file
create_sequence_dataloader_KittiDataModu: build a sequence-aware PyTorch DataLoader that groups KITTI images by date drive and chunks them
